channel.title: DevPulse · Cloud & infra
channel.description: Daily cloud & infra stories worth an engineer's time.

item.title: Floci runs AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI service emulators locally
item.description: Floci offers local emulators for four cloud providers; its page reports 24 ms startup for AWS and 13 MiB idle memory for Azure, with no cloud credentials required. Local cloud APIs can speed up development and give AI agents a credential-free environment to exercise integrations.

item.title: Cloudflare Cache Rules add controls for Vary-based cache entries
item.description: Cache Rules can normalize selected request headers, pass their exact values through, or bypass caching when Vary creates too many distinct entries. These controls address the trade-off between serving correct responses and keeping caches reusable.

item.title: systemd 262 can build as a static binary for small containers
item.description: systemd 262 adds a statically linked single-binary build option for small containers, along with Linux 6.17 coredump socket support and OpenSSL 4 support. The container option is relevant to engineers working on compact runtime environments.

item.title: Cloudflare Python Workers reach general availability on Pyodide and WebAssembly
item.description: Cloudflare runs Python compiled with Pyodide in its V8-based workerd runtime, while the local tool simulates that stack in a 123 MB binary; threading and multiprocessing do not work in the WebAssembly VM. The implementation and runtime limitations help teams evaluate Python on Workers.
